caption: The drawing is a technical illustration of a "SOFA TABLE" made of mahogany, presented in a black ink line drawing on a beige paper background. The drawing features several views and details of the table: a top view, a front elevation, a side elevation, and a detailed view of the wing bracket mechanism. The top view shows the table as a long rectangular shape with rounded, scalloped sides, labeled with "4 Legs," "4 Drawers," and "4 Brackets." The front elevation details the brass handles on the drawers and the reeded pattern and brass feet on the legs, with a length measurement of 60 inches and a height of 28 inches. The side elevation shows the profile of one leg and the table’s structure. The detailed view depicts a bracket with a hinge mechanism. Annotations in the drawing identify materials (brass for handles and foot casters, mahogany for the table), decorative features (reeds), and structural elements (drawers, brackets, and legs). The composition is arranged with each view aligned carefully, and all text is rendered in capital letters for clarity. The artist’s signature, "I. SOVENSKY," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Sofa Table
